statements:
CREATE TABLE store_meta(
      singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),
      format TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(format)='text'), schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(schema_version=2),
      repo_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(repo_id)='text' AND length(repo_id)=32 AND repo_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), scope_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(scope_id)='text' AND length(scope_id)=32 AND scope_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), incarnation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(incarnation)='text' AND length(incarnation)=32 AND incarnation NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
      common_git_dir TEXT, common_dev INTEGER, common_ino INTEGER,
      project_rel TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(project_rel)='text'), git_object_format TEXT,
      repository_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(repository_json)='text'), settings_policy_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(settings_policy_digest)='text' AND length(settings_policy_digest)=64 AND settings_policy_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
      schema_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(schema_digest)='text' AND length(schema_digest)=64 AND schema_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), created_ns INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(created_ns)='integer' AND created_ns>=0))

CREATE TABLE worktrees(
      worktree_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(worktree_id)='text' AND length(worktree_id)=32 AND worktree_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') PRIMARY KEY,
      canonical_root TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, git_admin_dir TEXT UNIQUE,
      root_dev INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(root_dev)='integer' AND root_dev>=0), root_ino INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(root_ino)='integer' AND root_ino>=1), admin_dev INTEGER, admin_ino INTEGER,
      binding_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(binding_digest)='text' AND length(binding_digest)=64 AND binding_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') UNIQUE, binding_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(binding_json)='text'), project_root TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(project_root)='text'), record_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(record_json)='text'),
      settings_path TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(settings_path)='text'), settings_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(settings_sha)='text' AND length(settings_sha)=64 AND settings_sha NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), policy_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(policy_digest)='text' AND length(policy_digest)=64 AND policy_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), wiki_root TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(wiki_root)='text'),
      wiki_dev INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(wiki_dev)='integer' AND wiki_dev>=0), wiki_ino INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(wiki_ino)='integer' AND wiki_ino>=1), registered_ns INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(registered_ns)='integer' AND registered_ns>=0))

CREATE TABLE wiki_blobs(
      blob_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(blob_sha)='text' AND length(blob_sha)=64 AND blob_sha NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') PRIMARY KEY, body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(body)='text'),
      byte_length INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(byte_length)='integer' AND byte_length>=0), created_ns INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(created_ns)='integer' AND created_ns>=0),
      CHECK(byte_length=length(CAST(body AS BLOB))))

CREATE TABLE blob_admissions(
      blob_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(blob_sha)='text' AND length(blob_sha)=64 AND blob_sha NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES wiki_blobs(blob_sha),
      worktree_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(worktree_id)='text' AND length(worktree_id)=32 AND worktree_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') REFERENCES worktrees(worktree_id),
      proof_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(proof_digest)='text' AND length(proof_digest)=64 AND proof_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), proof_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(proof_json)='text'), created_ns INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(created_ns)='integer' AND created_ns>=0))

CREATE TABLE chunk_recipes(
      recipe_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(recipe_id)='text' AND length(recipe_id)=64 AND recipe_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') PRIMARY KEY, canonical_spec TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(canonical_spec)='text') CHECK(json_valid(canonical_spec)))

CREATE TABLE vector_profiles(
      profile_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(profile_id)='text' AND length(profile_id)=64 AND profile_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') PRIMARY KEY, model_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(model_id)='text'), model_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(model_sha)='text' AND length(model_sha)=64 AND model_sha NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
      embedding_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(embedding_fingerprint)='text' AND length(embedding_fingerprint)=64 AND embedding_fingerprint NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), input_recipe TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(input_recipe)='text') CHECK(json_valid(input_recipe)),
      dimension INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(dimension)='integer' AND dimension>=1) CHECK(dimension<=2048), metric TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(metric)='text') CHECK(metric='cosine'),
      canonical_spec TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(canonical_spec)='text') CHECK(json_valid(canonical_spec)))

CREATE TABLE chunk_sets(
      blob_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(blob_sha)='text' AND length(blob_sha)=64 AND blob_sha NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') REFERENCES wiki_blobs(blob_sha),
      recipe_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(recipe_id)='text' AND length(recipe_id)=64 AND recipe_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') REFERENCES chunk_recipes(recipe_id),
      chunk_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(chunk_count)='integer' AND chunk_count>=1) CHECK(chunk_count<=1024), set_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(set_digest)='text' AND length(set_digest)=64 AND set_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
      PRIMARY KEY(blob_sha,recipe_id))

CREATE TABLE chunks(
      blob_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(blob_sha)='text' AND length(blob_sha)=64 AND blob_sha NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), recipe_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(recipe_id)='text' AND length(recipe_id)=64 AND recipe_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(seq)='integer' AND seq>=0), position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(position)='integer' AND position>=0),
      text TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(text)='text'), text_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(text_sha)='text' AND length(text_sha)=64 AND text_sha NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), PRIMARY KEY(blob_sha,recipe_id,seq),
      FOREIGN KEY(blob_sha,recipe_id) REFERENCES chunk_sets(blob_sha,recipe_id))

CREATE TABLE embedding_sets(
      blob_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(blob_sha)='text' AND length(blob_sha)=64 AND blob_sha NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), recipe_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(recipe_id)='text' AND length(recipe_id)=64 AND recipe_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
      profile_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(profile_id)='text' AND length(profile_id)=64 AND profile_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') REFERENCES vector_profiles(profile_id),
      chunk_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(chunk_count)='integer' AND chunk_count>=1) CHECK(chunk_count<=1024), set_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(set_digest)='text' AND length(set_digest)=64 AND set_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
      PRIMARY KEY(blob_sha,recipe_id,profile_id),
      FOREIGN KEY(blob_sha,recipe_id) REFERENCES chunk_sets(blob_sha,recipe_id))

CREATE TABLE vectors(
      blob_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(blob_sha)='text' AND length(blob_sha)=64 AND blob_sha NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), recipe_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(recipe_id)='text' AND length(recipe_id)=64 AND recipe_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), profile_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(profile_id)='text' AND length(profile_id)=64 AND profile_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(seq)='integer' AND seq>=0),
      input_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(input_sha)='text' AND length(input_sha)=64 AND input_sha NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), embedding BLOB NOT NULL
        CHECK(typeof(embedding)='blob' AND length(embedding) BETWEEN 4 AND 8192 AND length(embedding)%4=0),
      provenance_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(provenance_digest)='text' AND length(provenance_digest)=64 AND provenance_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), PRIMARY KEY(blob_sha,recipe_id,profile_id,seq),
      FOREIGN KEY(blob_sha,recipe_id,seq) REFERENCES chunks(blob_sha,recipe_id,seq),
      FOREIGN KEY(blob_sha,recipe_id,profile_id) REFERENCES embedding_sets(blob_sha,recipe_id,profile_id))

CREATE TABLE source_fingerprints(
      fingerprint_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(fingerprint_id)='text' AND length(fingerprint_id)=64 AND fingerprint_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') PRIMARY KEY,
      worktree_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(worktree_id)='text' AND length(worktree_id)=32 AND worktree_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') REFERENCES worktrees(worktree_id),
      branch_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(branch_key)='text'), path TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(path)='text'), source_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(source_sha)='text' AND length(source_sha)=64 AND source_sha NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), byte_length INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(byte_length)='integer' AND byte_length>=0),
      head_oid TEXT CHECK(head_oid IS NULL OR typeof(head_oid)='text'),
      tracked_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(tracked_state)='text') CHECK(tracked_state IN ('tracked','untracked','unknown')),
      binding_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(binding_state)='text') CHECK(binding_state IN ('observed','legacy_unbound')),
      scan_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(scan_id)='text' AND length(scan_id)=32 AND scan_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), observed_ns INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(observed_ns)='integer' AND observed_ns>=0))

CREATE TABLE card_attestations(
      trust_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(trust_digest)='text' AND length(trust_digest)=64 AND trust_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') PRIMARY KEY,
      blob_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(blob_sha)='text' AND length(blob_sha)=64 AND blob_sha NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') REFERENCES wiki_blobs(blob_sha),
      verification_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(verification_kind)='text') CHECK(verification_kind IN ('compiled','rebound','legacy_verified')),
      engine_identity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(engine_identity)='text'), policy_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(policy_digest)='text' AND length(policy_digest)=64 AND policy_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), provenance_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(provenance_digest)='text' AND length(provenance_digest)=64 AND provenance_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
      receipt_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(receipt_json)='text') CHECK(json_valid(receipt_json)),
      source_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(source_count)='integer' AND source_count>=0) CHECK(source_count<=64), created_ns INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(created_ns)='integer' AND created_ns>=0),
      UNIQUE(trust_digest,blob_sha))

CREATE TABLE attestation_sources(
      trust_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(trust_digest)='text' AND length(trust_digest)=64 AND trust_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') REFERENCES card_attestations(trust_digest),
      ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(ordinal)='integer' AND ordinal>=0) CHECK(ordinal<64),
      fingerprint_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(fingerprint_id)='text' AND length(fingerprint_id)=64 AND fingerprint_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') REFERENCES source_fingerprints(fingerprint_id),
      spans_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(spans_json)='text') CHECK(json_valid(spans_json)),
      PRIMARY KEY(trust_digest,ordinal), UNIQUE(trust_digest,fingerprint_id))

CREATE TABLE views(
        view_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(view_id)='text' AND length(view_id)=64 AND view_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') PRIMARY KEY, worktree_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(worktree_id)='text' AND length(worktree_id)=32 AND worktree_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') REFERENCES worktrees(worktree_id),
        branch_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(branch_key)='text'), UNIQUE(worktree_id,branch_key))

CREATE TABLE generation_slots(
        ordinal INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT CHECK(ordinal>0),
        build_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(build_id)='text' AND length(build_id)=32 AND build_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') UNIQUE, view_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(view_id)='text' AND length(view_id)=64 AND view_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') REFERENCES views(view_id),
        manifest_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(manifest_digest)='text' AND length(manifest_digest)=64 AND manifest_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), stage_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(stage_json)='text') CHECK(json_valid(stage_json)),
        created_ns INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(created_ns)='integer' AND created_ns>=0))

CREATE TABLE generations(
        ordinal INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES generation_slots(ordinal) CHECK(ordinal>0),
        gen_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(gen_id)='text') UNIQUE CHECK(length(gen_id)=100 AND substr(gen_id,1,2)='g-'
          AND substr(gen_id,35,2)='-b' AND substr(gen_id,3,32) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
          AND substr(gen_id,37)=binding_digest),
        view_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(view_id)='text' AND length(view_id)=64 AND view_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') REFERENCES views(view_id), parent_gen TEXT REFERENCES generations(gen_id),
        head_oid TEXT, checkout_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(checkout_digest)='text' AND length(checkout_digest)=64 AND checkout_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), checkout_evidence TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(checkout_evidence)='text') CHECK(json_valid(checkout_evidence)),
        scan_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(scan_id)='text' AND length(scan_id)=32 AND scan_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), policy_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(policy_digest)='text' AND length(policy_digest)=64 AND policy_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), revocation_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(revocation_epoch)='integer' AND revocation_epoch>=0),
        state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(state)='text') CHECK(state IN ('building','prepared','published')),
        binding_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(binding_digest)='text' AND length(binding_digest)=64 AND binding_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), created_ns INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(created_ns)='integer' AND created_ns>=0), UNIQUE(gen_id,view_id))

CREATE TABLE wiki_members(
        gen_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(gen_id)='text') REFERENCES generations(gen_id), path TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(path)='text'),
        blob_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(blob_sha)='text' AND length(blob_sha)=64 AND blob_sha NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') REFERENCES wiki_blobs(blob_sha), display_title TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(display_title)='text'),
        eligible INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(eligible)='integer' AND eligible>=0) CHECK(eligible IN (0,1)), trust_digest TEXT,
        CHECK(eligible=0 OR trust_digest IS NOT NULL),
        PRIMARY KEY(gen_id,path), UNIQUE(gen_id,path,blob_sha),
        FOREIGN KEY(trust_digest,blob_sha) REFERENCES card_attestations(trust_digest,blob_sha))

CREATE TABLE source_members(
        gen_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(gen_id)='text') REFERENCES generations(gen_id), path TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(path)='text'),
        fingerprint_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(fingerprint_id)='text' AND length(fingerprint_id)=64 AND fingerprint_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') REFERENCES source_fingerprints(fingerprint_id),
        presence TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(presence)='text') CHECK(presence IN ('present','held_missing')),
        PRIMARY KEY(gen_id,path))

CREATE TABLE card_sources(
        gen_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(gen_id)='text'), wiki_path TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(wiki_path)='text'), ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(ordinal)='integer' AND ordinal>=0),
        fingerprint_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(fingerprint_id)='text' AND length(fingerprint_id)=64 AND fingerprint_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') REFERENCES source_fingerprints(fingerprint_id),
        spans_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(spans_json)='text') CHECK(json_valid(spans_json)), PRIMARY KEY(gen_id,wiki_path,ordinal),
        FOREIGN KEY(gen_id,wiki_path) REFERENCES wiki_members(gen_id,path))

CREATE TABLE generation_seals(
        gen_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(gen_id)='text') PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES generations(gen_id),
        membership_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(membership_digest)='text' AND length(membership_digest)=64 AND membership_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), sources_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(sources_digest)='text' AND length(sources_digest)=64 AND sources_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), trust_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(trust_digest)='text' AND length(trust_digest)=64 AND trust_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
        lexical_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(lexical_digest)='text' AND length(lexical_digest)=64 AND lexical_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), fts_storage_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(fts_storage_digest)='text' AND length(fts_storage_digest)=64 AND fts_storage_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), vectors_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(vectors_digest)='text' AND length(vectors_digest)=64 AND vectors_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
        binding_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(binding_digest)='text' AND length(binding_digest)=64 AND binding_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), eligible_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(eligible_count)='integer' AND eligible_count>=0),
        vector_member_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(vector_member_count)='integer' AND vector_member_count>=0) CHECK(vector_member_count=0), sealed_ns INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(sealed_ns)='integer' AND sealed_ns>=0))

CREATE TABLE view_heads(
        view_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(view_id)='text' AND length(view_id)=64 AND view_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES views(view_id), gen_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(gen_id)='text'),
        epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(epoch)='integer' AND epoch>=1), FOREIGN KEY(gen_id,view_id) REFERENCES generations(gen_id,view_id))

CREATE TRIGGER store_meta_duplicate BEFORE INSERT ON store_meta
          WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM store_meta WHERE singleton=NEW.singleton) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER store_meta_update BEFORE UPDATE ON store_meta
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER store_meta_delete BEFORE DELETE ON store_meta
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER worktrees_duplicate BEFORE INSERT ON worktrees
          WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM worktrees WHERE worktree_id=NEW.worktree_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM worktrees WHERE canonical_root=NEW.canonical_root) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM worktrees WHERE git_admin_dir=NEW.git_admin_dir) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM worktrees WHERE binding_digest=NEW.binding_digest) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER worktrees_update BEFORE UPDATE ON worktrees
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER worktrees_delete BEFORE DELETE ON worktrees
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER wiki_blobs_duplicate BEFORE INSERT ON wiki_blobs
          WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wiki_blobs WHERE blob_sha=NEW.blob_sha) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER wiki_blobs_update BEFORE UPDATE ON wiki_blobs
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER wiki_blobs_delete BEFORE DELETE ON wiki_blobs
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER blob_admissions_duplicate BEFORE INSERT ON blob_admissions
          WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM blob_admissions WHERE blob_sha=NEW.blob_sha) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER blob_admissions_update BEFORE UPDATE ON blob_admissions
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER blob_admissions_delete BEFORE DELETE ON blob_admissions
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER chunk_recipes_duplicate BEFORE INSERT ON chunk_recipes
          WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM chunk_recipes WHERE recipe_id=NEW.recipe_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER chunk_recipes_update BEFORE UPDATE ON chunk_recipes
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER chunk_recipes_delete BEFORE DELETE ON chunk_recipes
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER vector_profiles_duplicate BEFORE INSERT ON vector_profiles
          WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM vector_profiles WHERE profile_id=NEW.profile_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER vector_profiles_update BEFORE UPDATE ON vector_profiles
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER vector_profiles_delete BEFORE DELETE ON vector_profiles
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER chunk_sets_duplicate BEFORE INSERT ON chunk_sets
          WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM chunk_sets WHERE blob_sha=NEW.blob_sha AND recipe_id=NEW.recipe_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER chunk_sets_update BEFORE UPDATE ON chunk_sets
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER chunk_sets_delete BEFORE DELETE ON chunk_sets
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER chunks_duplicate BEFORE INSERT ON chunks
          WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM chunks WHERE blob_sha=NEW.blob_sha AND recipe_id=NEW.recipe_id AND seq=NEW.seq) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER chunks_update BEFORE UPDATE ON chunks
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER chunks_delete BEFORE DELETE ON chunks
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER embedding_sets_duplicate BEFORE INSERT ON embedding_sets
          WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM embedding_sets WHERE blob_sha=NEW.blob_sha AND recipe_id=NEW.recipe_id AND profile_id=NEW.profile_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER embedding_sets_update BEFORE UPDATE ON embedding_sets
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER embedding_sets_delete BEFORE DELETE ON embedding_sets
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER vectors_duplicate BEFORE INSERT ON vectors
          WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM vectors WHERE blob_sha=NEW.blob_sha AND recipe_id=NEW.recipe_id AND profile_id=NEW.profile_id AND seq=NEW.seq) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER vectors_update BEFORE UPDATE ON vectors
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER vectors_delete BEFORE DELETE ON vectors
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER source_fingerprints_duplicate BEFORE INSERT ON source_fingerprints
          WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM source_fingerprints WHERE fingerprint_id=NEW.fingerprint_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER source_fingerprints_update BEFORE UPDATE ON source_fingerprints
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER source_fingerprints_delete BEFORE DELETE ON source_fingerprints
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER card_attestations_duplicate BEFORE INSERT ON card_attestations
          WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM card_attestations WHERE trust_digest=NEW.trust_digest) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER card_attestations_update BEFORE UPDATE ON card_attestations
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER card_attestations_delete BEFORE DELETE ON card_attestations
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER attestation_sources_duplicate BEFORE INSERT ON attestation_sources
          WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM attestation_sources WHERE trust_digest=NEW.trust_digest AND ordinal=NEW.ordinal) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM attestation_sources WHERE trust_digest=NEW.trust_digest AND fingerprint_id=NEW.fingerprint_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER attestation_sources_update BEFORE UPDATE ON attestation_sources
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER attestation_sources_delete BEFORE DELETE ON attestation_sources
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER generation_slots_duplicate BEFORE INSERT ON generation_slots
          WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM generation_slots WHERE ordinal=NEW.ordinal) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM generation_slots WHERE build_id=NEW.build_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER generation_slots_update BEFORE UPDATE ON generation_slots
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER generation_slots_delete BEFORE DELETE ON generation_slots
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER views_duplicate BEFORE INSERT ON views
          WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM views WHERE view_id=NEW.view_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM views WHERE worktree_id=NEW.worktree_id AND branch_key=NEW.branch_key) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER views_update BEFORE UPDATE ON views
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER views_delete BEFORE DELETE ON views
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER wiki_members_duplicate BEFORE INSERT ON wiki_members
          WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wiki_members WHERE gen_id=NEW.gen_id AND path=NEW.path) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER wiki_members_update BEFORE UPDATE ON wiki_members
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER wiki_members_delete BEFORE DELETE ON wiki_members
              BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_row'); END

CREATE TRIGGER source_members_duplicate BEFORE INSERT ON source_members

CREATE TRIGGER generation_insert BEFORE INSERT ON generations
        WHEN NEW.state!='building' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM generations WHERE gen_id=NEW.gen_id OR ordinal=NEW.ordinal)
          OR (NEW.parent_gen IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(
            SELECT 1 FROM generations p WHERE p.gen_id=NEW.parent_gen AND p.view_id=NEW.view_id AND p.state='published'))
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'generation_insert_invalid'); END

CREATE TRIGGER generation_delete BEFORE DELETE ON generations
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_generation'); END

CREATE TRIGGER generation_transition BEFORE UPDATE ON generations
        WHEN NOT ((OLD.state='building' AND NEW.state='prepared') OR (OLD.state='prepared' AND NEW.state='published'))
          OR NEW.ordinal IS NOT OLD.ordinal OR NEW.gen_id IS NOT OLD.gen_id
          OR NEW.view_id IS NOT OLD.view_id OR NEW.parent_gen IS NOT OLD.parent_gen
          OR NEW.head_oid IS NOT OLD.head_oid OR NEW.checkout_digest IS NOT OLD.checkout_digest
          OR NEW.checkout_evidence IS NOT OLD.checkout_evidence OR NEW.scan_id IS NOT OLD.scan_id
          OR NEW.policy_digest IS NOT OLD.policy_digest OR NEW.revocation_epoch IS NOT OLD.revocation_epoch
          OR NEW.binding_digest IS NOT OLD.binding_digest OR NEW.created_ns IS NOT OLD.created_ns
          OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM generation_seals s WHERE s.gen_id=NEW.gen_id AND s.binding_digest=NEW.binding_digest)
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'generation_transition_invalid'); END

CREATE TRIGGER view_head_insert BEFORE INSERT ON view_heads
        WHEN NEW.epoch!=1 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM view_heads WHERE view_id=NEW.view_id)
          OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM generations g JOIN generation_seals s ON s.gen_id=g.gen_id
            WHERE g.gen_id=NEW.gen_id AND g.view_id=NEW.view_id AND g.state='published')
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'view_head_invalid'); END

CREATE TRIGGER view_head_update BEFORE UPDATE ON view_heads
        WHEN NEW.view_id IS NOT OLD.view_id OR NEW.epoch!=OLD.epoch+1
          OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM generations g JOIN generation_seals s ON s.gen_id=g.gen_id
            WHERE g.gen_id=NEW.gen_id AND g.view_id=NEW.view_id AND g.state='published')
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'view_head_invalid'); END

CREATE TRIGGER view_head_delete BEFORE DELETE ON view_heads
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable_view_head'); END
